Implementation landed as Gerrit change 2093 (single commit 5f641d5d9fc).

MEASUREMENT (author run, docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py --block-impact
over /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker, 1262 code-v3 changes):
  correctness  0.54 -> 715 surviving, 62 would-block, 51 changes, 4.04% of all changes, mean val 1.00, min val 0.9286
  edge-cases   0.54 -> 485 surviving, 27 would-block, 22 changes, 1.74% of all changes, mean val 0.99, min val 0.9286
  concurrency  0.54 -> 1 surviving, 0 would-block, 0.0%
correctness and edge-cases FLIP to blocking@0.54 (both inside the 8.0% operator-accepted budget
recorded on the tests entry). concurrency HOLDS advisory: n=1 is far below the script's MIN_N=25
power floor, so 0.0% is absence of evidence.

CORRECTION TO THE ORIGINATING CLAIM (recorded in the doc and the commit message): the claim that
these criteria produced a priority-0.60 finding on c3aec3eae6 is FALSE against the committed
corpus. That change's stored code-v3 sidecar carries the finding on ['correctness',
'maintainability'] at priority 0.3857 / validity 0.7143 - below 0.54, so the flip would NOT have
recalled it. d2dea317ec has NO code-v3 sidecar at all, so no recall statement is measurable for
it. The flips rest on the precision/friction profile only.

MUTATION EVIDENCE for tests/unit/test_code_review_criteria_routing.py (each perturbation applied
to the live path, then reverted; the named test went RED):
  doc '4.04%' -> '9.04%'                     -> test_every_blocking_row_stays_inside_the_friction_budget FAILED
  routing correctness blocking_enabled->false -> test_document_decision_column_matches_the_routed_posture + test_replay_script_advertises_the_routed_blocking_set FAILED
  doc edge-cases decision flip->hold          -> test_document_decision_column_matches_the_routed_posture FAILED
  routing edge-cases block_threshold 0.54->0.60 -> test_document_decision_column_matches_the_routed_posture FAILED
  replay blocking_set reverted to a literal tuple -> test_replay_script_advertises_the_routed_blocking_set FAILED
  block_impact of_all_changes numerator len(hits)->would_block -> test_block_impact_columns_are_computed_from_the_surviving_pools FAILED

PROCESS NOTE: a second session was writing in the same /Users/joeoakhart/impl-4144 directory
(the coordinator's 4-hex-prefix collision, AGENTS.md's deprecated reference form) and committed
and pushed the same working tree, producing two Gerrit changes (2092, 2093) for this one ticket.
2092 was abandoned; 2093 has been rebuilt as a single self-contained commit on origin/main with
the identical tree. Work continues from the private worktree /Users/joeoakhart/impl-4144-2784.
